mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 53 degrees near the Verona Public Library under a waning crescent moon. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain forecasted.

In city news, the Public Works department is introducing a new leaf vacuum truck to make fall collection more efficient. Remember that only loose leaves are collected, so please keep brush and pumpkins separate.
You have plenty of local fun to look forward to, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
The Verona Police Department reported a notable incident on October 3, where a 19-year-old man was arrested for possession of a stolen firearm and other charges.
Today's flavor of the day was Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently closed for the evening, but you can head back tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to try the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
